{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Report the number of unique patients and duplicates
n_unique_patients = len(df['patient_id'].unique())
n_duplicate_patients = len(duplicates)

print(f'Unique patient_ids: {n_unique_patients}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids (re-tested): {n_duplicate_patients}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')

# Verify that the highest sample_seq per patient is the one to keep
# Group by patient_id and find the max sample_seq
max_sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Confirm that some patients have >1 sample_seq
n_with_multiple_tests = (max_sample_seq_per_patient > 1).sum()
print(f'Patients with multiple tests (sample_seq > 1): {n_with_multiple_tests}')"}
